features.description: Both directly addressed gewītan commands.
Past factual ðā-clause with indicative, optionally correlated with main-clause ðā then.
Recurring/future temporal ðonne-clause, optionally correlated with main-clause ðonne then; not a blanket subjunctive rule.
Factual simultaneous events with indicative; the spelling identifies a conjunction phrase.
Temporal clause, including factual past narration; distinguish the lexicalized conjunction from a freely parsed means phrase.
Selected anticipated event after a command with subjunctive; past factual before may also use subjunctive viewpoint. No indicative-only/future-only generalization.
Selected anticipated endpoint with subjunctive; no universal tense-sequence doctrine.
Purpose of prevention with subjunctive; negative meaning belongs to this conjunction and is not an instruction to negate the main clause.
Normally subjunctive, including admitted facts; subjunctive alone does not mean uncertainty.
Adversative coordination of clauses or parallel predicates; no subordinating mood requirement.
Through+accusative, literal spatial path; selected þ spelling is independently evidenced in Fulk199; Cook exact ðurh stays separately recorded.
Accusative opponent with feohtan; not the modern English accompaniment use of with.
rīsan ūp, rise up; opposition supplied by ongēan+accusative, not by ūp alone.
Besides+ dative in the assigned counting exclusion; does not teach every sense of būtan.
Factual cause with for-ðon-ðe; prior for-ðām retained.
Purpose ðæt with subjunctive; present and past examples bounded to the given contexts.
features.scope_note: No systematic sequence-of-tense doctrine; modal source clauses separately supplied.

features.description: Asserted swā…ðæt result normally indicative.
Contextually contrary-present gif-clause and main clause with preterite subjunctive.
features.scope_note: Speaker explicitly knows the condition is false now; no automatic gif mood, no full past counterfactual system.

features.description: Distinguish conjunction and correlative adverb; dependent verb-late/main second-position tendencies aid parsing.
features.scope_note: Tendencies, not mechanically obligatory reorderings.

features.description: Temporal relative ðe after a time antecedent: the day when an event occurred.
features.scope_note: Bounded Cook18.7 frame, distinct from direct-question hwonne and ordinary nominal relative roles.

features.description: Adverb mā with ðonne comparing amounts of doing; repeated predicate may be explicit or omitted.
features.scope_note: Cook18.13 bounded verbal comparison; not merely prior copular adjective comparison.

features.description: Finite swā clause compares asserted actions: as; in the same way as.
features.scope_note: Selected factual indicative comparison in Cook18.5; distinguish adverb swā so and other source conjunction senses.

features.description: Bare strong genitive plurals dēadra/cwicra denote dead/living persons.
features.scope_note: No article in the assigned construction; distinct from earlier article+weak personal adjectives.

features.description: Article plus weak rihtwīs/unrihtwīs denotes righteous/unrighteous people.
features.scope_note: Explicitly extends the prior selected personal-adjective construction to rihtwīs; no assumption that familiar adjectival morphology already taught every personal sense.

features.description: Bounded nālæs hōlunga: not at all in vain, denying that the stated fighting was fruitless.
features.scope_note: Selected emphatic negative-adverb phrase. Do not mechanically require an additional ne; no general negative-concord system or unrestricted nālæs syntax is taught.

features.description: Substantival eall: ealle all people (masculine plural) or eall everything (neuter singular).
features.scope_note: Cook16.13 permits either bounded interpretation if the number/meaning is stated; independent unspecified all is not a new noun paradigm.

features.description: Weak personal adjective used alone in singular direct address: lēofosta/lēofoste dearest.
features.scope_note: Gender of addressee must be stated or a defensible alternative accepted; extends prior adjective+noun vocative to the bare adjective.

features.description: New participle bases used in the already taught bare-predicate passive construction.
features.scope_note: Reuses actual u07-predicate-participle-variants; full participial adjective declensions and new plural cells are not implied.

features.description: Parenthetic ic ðē bidde: biddan takes the person entreated in accusative.
features.scope_note: Bounded parenthetic request; no general object or clause-complement system for biddan is inferred.

features.description: Supplied nis in Cook17.12 and supplied ne sindon in the negative plural passive of Cook17.5.
features.scope_note: Nis is an exact listed contraction. Ne sindon is declared local composition from Cook sindon and Fulk ne-before-verb; Fulk199 line60 independently attests ne sindan. No full negative wesan paradigm or independent uncontracted ne is production.

features.description: hīeran obey + dative.
dōn put/place accusative object into on+accusative goal.
feohtan + wið accusative opponent.
Plain scēawian after volitional willan with accusative object watched.
genēalǣcan approach with dative, including temporal approach.
scęððan injure takes selected dative patient.
bringan accusative person/object + tō dative destination/person.
fōn catches an accusative animal/person/object; agentless passive presents the caught entity as subject.
features.scope_note: New lexical government milestone; previous fon-1 taught morphology and catch gloss but explicitly did not teach object case.

features.description: Supplied wesan+ācenned for was born in Cook18.7.
features.scope_note: Exact hinted participle, local support only.
